visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) NiNiRu introduces the video in a close-up, showcasing her braided hair styled with snowflake clips. She is dressed in a black t-shirt featuring the ROG logo. The background is a large indoor event space with high ceilings and industrial lighting, filled with various equipment and people preparing for the event. (2) The camera pans to reveal the venue's interior, showing multiple workstations equipped with PC components and monitors. A large LED screen in the center displays promotional material for the 'ASUS Campus PC Building Contest.' Staff members are seen organizing the area and interacting with attendees. (3) NiNiRu moves through the crowd, interacting playfully with a male friend who is recording her with a smartphone. Another young woman joins the frame, and they chat while surrounded by branding for Republic of Gamers. (4) On the main stage, NiNiRu holds a branded microphone and speaks enthusiastically to a large, diverse audience. The background is dominated by a large digital screen featuring her portrait and the event's title. The camera captures her from a medium shot, highlighting her role as the event ambassador. (5) The competition phase begins with fast-paced cuts showing several male contestants assembling desktop computers. They are seen handling motherboards, inserting RAM, and managing cables within black PC cases. NiNiRu and a male co-host provide live commentary from the stage side. (6) Winners of the first round are celebrated with onscreen graphics and cheering. The atmosphere is energetic as NiNiRu interviews the winning team on stage. The camera uses quick pans and medium shots to capture the excitement and the contestants' reactions. (7) The final sequence shows a photo session where NiNiRu poses with fans and a person in detailed mecha-style cosplay. They are standing in a themed photo booth with ROG and Intel branding.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop track that serves as the background music. NiNiRu's voice is front and center, characterized by a high pitch and a friendly, energetic tone. Her speech rate is fast, conveying excitement as she introduces the ASUS event. (2) A distinct 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to the stage. This is followed by the sound of a large crowd cheering and applauding loudly. NiNiRu's voice takes on a professional, amplified quality as if speaking through a PA system, with a moderate amount of natural reverb from the large hall. (3) As the PC building competition starts, the BGM changes to a more intense, driving electronic beat with a higher BPM. A male co-host's voice enters, speaking with high arousal and volume, mimicking the style of a sports commentator. The sounds of metal cases clinking and fans humming are subtly audible. (4) A surge in crowd noise—including whistling and chanting—occurs during the climax of the competition. The co-host shouts energetically to announce the winners, and his voice exhibits high spectral tension. The background music maintains its fast tempo, synchronizing with the rapid editing of the visuals. (5) The final phase features several 'click' sound effects representing camera shutters during the photo session. NiNiRu's voice returns to a more casual, narrative style as she expresses her passion for the event. The BGM softens into a warm melodic outro before the audio track ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Event Intro -> Rules/Prep -> Competition Highlights -> Conclusion/Photos
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional vlog documenting the '2024 ASUS Campus PC Building Contest' at Huashan 1914 Creative Park. It aims to showcase the competitive atmosphere of the event, highlight ASUS/ROG brand presence, and leverage NiNiRu's personality to engage the gaming and tech community.
